text:
Dina R.: Quick flag: CloudBurst sent INV-CB-2026-11 for $19,120 but the PDF header doesn't show a PO. Vendor says payment is due in 12 days and asked us to confirm PO so they don't get late. Can procurement check if there's a matching PO or if we ask for a reissue?
Invoices Bot: New invoice uploaded: INV-CB-2026-11 • amount $19,120 • status: unmatched. Link: https://accounting.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-CB-2026-11
Kofi (Procurement): Looking up contracts... I see PO-84099 for CloudBurst monthly reserved capacity $18k. This invoice includes an additional usage spike $1,120 for burst tokens. It looks like their system didn't attach PO when overages exist.
CloudBurst Billing: Hi all, apologies. Our billing engine omits PO on the rendered PDF when auto-generated overage lines exist. We can reissue INV-CB-2026-11-R1 with PO-84099 on the header and break out $18,000 applied to PO and $1,120 as overage. Do you want both PO numbers if procurement creates a supplemental PO?
Dina R.: Reissue with PO-84099 on header and clear line items is preferred. If procurement will create a supplemental PO for the overage (PO-84099-S1) please include both on the invoice.
Marta (AP): If PO is present on header we can auto-match the $18k. The $1,120 overage needs cost owner approval and finance lead review because total >15k triggers extra review. Please include GL mapping and remittance details on the reissue.
Anika (Finance Manager): Routing policy: any invoice >15k gets routed to me for review. If procurement supplies PO-84099-S1 for the overage that will help expedite AP matching. Cost center should be eng-infra and GL 5110-INF-OPS.
Kofi (Procurement): I'll issue a supplemental PO-84099-S1 for the $1,120 and ask CloudBurst to include both PO-84099 and PO-84099-S1 on the reissue. I'll also request a short usage explanation for the cost owner.
CloudBurst Billing: Understood. We'll upload INV-CB-2026-11-R1 today with PO-84099 and PO-84099-S1 on the header, line-item breakdown, GL field, and remittance/bank details.
Invoices Bot: Invoice INV-CB-2026-11-R1 uploaded • amount $19,120 • status: pending match. Link: https://accounting.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-CB-2026-11-R1
Marta (AP): Received. Matched $18,000 to PO-84099. Routing $1,120 overage to Anika for finance lead approval.
Anika (Finance Manager): Reviewed usage note from procurement. Approve routing and charge to GL 5110-INF-OPS, cost center eng-infra. Clear for payment scheduling.
Marta (AP): Scheduling payment on the next AP run. Noted vendor corrected bank details.
Dina R.: Thanks team. I'll file the vendor ticket: "CloudBurst invoice omitted PO when usage exceeded commitment; reissued INV-CB-2026-11-R1 with PO-84099 + PO-84099-S1; charge GL 5110-INF-OPS; routed to Anika; payment scheduled." :white_check_mark:
CloudBurst Billing: Thanks, and sorry again for the header omission. We'll change our export to always include PO fields even when auto-generated overage lines present.
